verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for an agent product, so the axis applies. A runtime probe of the full grok-bot docs section found no public Grok Bot CLI, API, or MCP endpoint; the product is driven through its desktop and mobile apps. The Linux .deb/.rpm/AppImage packages are installers for the desktop app, and the 'terminal' runs on the Bot's own cloud computer, so neither is a user-facing CLI.
